comment: genl_player_setup() asks 'Shall I pick ... for you? [ynaq]' with yn_function(prompt, NULL, '\0'); tty_yn_function() appends a space and writes the prompt through update_topl(), whose topl_putsym() never writes the last column. With only role:Priest the prompt is 79 characters, so the appended space wraps to row 1 and leaves the cursor there. 'x' is not an answer and asks again; 'a' picks the rest and starts. A second segment names a human Caveman, whose 80-character prompt puts its closing bracket on row 1.
